headline: Parents Sentenced For 1987 Murder Of Girl Found Along French Road
seoTitle: Parents Convicted in 1987 Cold Case Murder
metaDescription: A French court has sentenced two parents to prison for the 1987 death of their daughter, whose body was found by an A10 motorway decades ago.
aiSummaryBullets: A French court sentenced a mother to 20 years and a father to 15 years for the death of their four-year-old daughter.
The victim's body was discovered alongside the A10 motorway in 1987, but the case remained unresolved for decades.
Investigators were only able to officially identify the child as Inass Touloub in 2018, leading to the eventual trial of the parents.
aiContextParagraph: The legal proceedings follow the long-standing mystery of a child's death that began with the discovery of a body along the A10 motorway in 1987. For over thirty years, the victim remained unidentified while exhibiting clear signs of physical abuse. It was not until 2018 that authorities successfully identified the girl as Inass Touloub, prompting a significant breakthrough in the criminal investigation. Following this identification, the parents were brought to trial to answer for the abuse and death of their daughter. The mother received a 20-year prison sentence for torturing the child to death, while the father was sentenced to 15 years for his complicity in the act. Legal representatives for the father have indicated that an appeal against the court's decision is expected in the near future.
whyItIsViral: The story is currently being tracked across two independent news outlets with a moderate pace of coverage reporting.
